r1.name: Large Cash Transaction
r1.regulation_note: Cash transactions at or above INR 10,00,000 are reportable to FIU-IND under the PMLA reporting rules.

r2.name: Structuring
r2.regulation_note: Multiple transactions kept just below the CTR threshold indicate structuring; report as suspicious activity.

r3.name: Rapid Pass-Through
r3.regulation_note: Funds moved out within 24 hours of receipt indicate mule-account behaviour.

r4.name: Dormant Account Reactivation
r4.regulation_note: Long-dormant accounts suddenly moving large amounts are a classic takeover indicator.

r5.name: Watchlist Hit
r5.regulation_note: Any transaction touching a sanctioned or watchlisted party must be reviewed the same day.

r6.name: KYC Gap
r6.regulation_note: Transactions on accounts with missing or expired KYC violate RBI customer due-diligence norms.

r7.name: High Velocity
r7.regulation_note: Abnormal transaction frequency suggests automated or bot-driven account abuse.

r8.name: Balance Drain
r8.regulation_note: Account emptied by transfer followed by immediate cash withdrawal is a typical cash-out pattern.
